title: The Simpsons Officially Brings Back Apu After 9 Years With New Voice Actor Revealed
content:
The Simpsons has officially reintroduced Apu to the animated series with a new voice actor after being missing in action for nearly a decade. The Simpsons Season 38 is now underway with new episodes airing this Fall, and with it fans have been treated to a second Treehouse of Horror Presents episode . But unlike the usual annual anthologies, this version of the special is allowed to tell other kinds of stories. Like explaining why Apu has been gone for such a long time.

The Simpsons Season 38 has now officially brought Apu back into the animated series nine years since he was last voiced by Hank Azaria, and Variety has confirmed that he’ll be now voiced by Sunil Malhotra ( The Legend of Vox Machina, Go Go Loser Ranger! ). The latest Halloween special episode even found a fun way to reintroduce him back into the fold as someone the town actively tried to ignore and forget.

The Simpsons Treehouse of Horror Presents Officially Reintroduces Apu

The Simpsons Season 38 “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening” takes place outside of the usual anthology and sees Springfield partying on Halloween night. Homer and a few others accidentally run over someone, and decide to hide the body instead of calling the police. When this person comes back for revenge the next year (much like seen in I Know What You Did Last Summer ), it turns out that the entire town had killed this same person and dumped the body over the course of the evening. This person turned out to be Apu.

Now voiced by Sunil Malhotra, this is the first time that Apu has openly spoken in The Simpsons since the Season 29 episode, “The Serfsons” back in 2017. Though the character has been spotted in a few crowd shots and background gags ( with as recent of an appearance in last year’s Treehouse of Horror episode ), this is an official reintroduction of the character. And is a way for the animated series to address head on that all of the characters (and the show itself) has been openly ignoring his absence for such a long time.

The Simpsons Finally Addresses Apu’s Absence

This story is developing…

HT – Variety

title: 3 Spooky Anime You Should Watch on Netflix This October
content:
In the past few years, Netflix has emerged as a major anime streaming platform, and it wouldn’t be far-fetched to call it the second-largest. It has achieved this by offering many of the same anime available on Crunchyroll, with fans increasingly turning to Netflix as their main source for anime.

With October approaching its end, Halloween is just around the corner, and Netflix has a variety of anime to match the spooky vibe. However, these three are among the most recent additions, including one released this year as a successor to a masterpiece, with one even receiving its second season this year.

3) Dandadan

First released in 2024, with its second season arriving in 2025, Dandadan is a modern anime that is bizarre , action-packed, and, most importantly, spooky. The anime’s entire premise revolves around supernatural elements, including ghosts and the existence of aliens. With two protagonists who believe in the existence of these spooky phenomena, the anime constantly delivers bizarre moments that the characters only continue to highlight.

What makes this anime even more special is how Science SARU, the studio behind its animation, has taken an approach that further amplifies its spookiness. This includes using distinct color themes for the ghosts and aliens featured in the series, giving it a unique vibe. With this approach, the anime is vibrant and full of color, yet spooky and scary at the same time. Honestly, there is no anime quite like Dandadan when it comes to delivering the perfect Halloween vibe, as it is just as funny as it is spooky.

2) Daemons of the Shadow Realm

Daemons of the Shadow Realm is a new anime that arrived in Spring 2026 and is the second series from the creator of Fullmetal Alchemist , earning it the title of the masterpiece’s successor. There were many expectations for the series; however, fans didn’t expect it to be spooky as well. From the start, the anime establishes a dark, action-heavy vibe while subtly incorporating spooky elements through the daemons, essentially spirits that help their wielders.

These beings have existed for a long time and always come in pairs. With many daemons being unveiled, their origins, abilities, and appearances can make them seem frightening, something the series doesn’t shy away from depicting. It strategically incorporates them into horror and comedy elements, keeping the anime engaging. With a total of 24 episodes and an engaging narrative, the series is perfect for fans looking for action-heavy anime with a touch of horror this October.

1) Cyberpunk: Edgerunners

The best spooky anime Netflix has to offer is none other than its exclusive Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, based on the popular video game franchise Cyberpunk 2077. The anime captures the perfect sci-fi and spooky vibe of Night City from the game, presenting characters immersed in its most compelling elements. As an original anime, it is exceptionally well-written, with characters’ actions impacting others in ways that are bound to make fans cry as they watch the narrative unfold.

Across just 10 episodes, this anime is scary, dark, emotional, and occasionally funny, making it perfect not just for its spooky elements but also for its overall vibe. However, the biggest reason fans should watch it is that the anime’s second season is arriving on October 20 . While the two seasons aren’t directly connected, as the second will feature its own narrative, watching the first season will reveal what makes this anime so amazing and why it won the Anime of the Year award. With the Netflix exclusive Cyberpunk: Edgerunners returning with a new season this October, there honestly can’t be a better anime to watch on the streaming platform, especially one that delivers the perfect Halloween vibe.

title: Boruto’s New Preview Hints at the New Hokage’s Replacement as Naruto Prepares to Return
content:
The new sneak peek for Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 hints that Shikamaru’s position as Hokage is being challenged. The chapter is only a couple of days away as of this writing, and as the series usually does before a release, it has unveiled a sneak peek. The first preview released for this chapter attracted significant attention from fans, as it hinted that Naruto might be making a return very soon. It depicted Kawaki talking to Naruto and Hinata, whom he had concealed, while apologizing to them and discussing how long they had been there.

This suggests that Kawaki might be ready to redeem his mistake and bring back Naruto and Hinata. Now, the latest sneak peek further solidifies the possibility that the series is preparing for Naruto’s return, seemingly by putting the current Hokage, Shikamaru, in a predicament. Ever since the climax of the previous arc began, with Mamushi fighting against Konoha, Kobu, the representative of the Fire Nation’s Daimyo , has suspected Shikamaru of various wrongdoings and remained determined to remove him from his position. Now, the sneak peek reveals that Kobu has obtained concrete evidence that could force Shikamaru out of office.

Boruto ’s New Preview Hints at Naruto Replacing Shikamaru as Hokage

The latest preview for Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 sees Kobu discussing his suspicions about Shikamaru, once again accusing him of being a traitor. However, he remains uncertain because he lacks concrete evidence. He claims that Shikamaru was the one who ordered Mitsuki to do what he did during the battle against Mamushi. The preview then introduces another Konoha shinobi who claims to have concrete evidence against Shikamaru. This is where the preview ends, leaving fans with a cliffhanger that hints at the existence of evidence without actually revealing it. On closer inspection, there could be several pieces of evidence, one of which might be Shikamaru’s telepathic communication with Boruto.

Shikamaru has been anxious about the entire situation, and despite his intelligence, the complexity of the circumstances might have left some loose ends. This appears to be what the shinobi has uncovered. The truth will soon come to light, potentially leading to Shikamaru’s replacement as Hokage. Perhaps this is precisely why the series is also hinting at Naruto’s return. Naruto has already served as Hokage, and his return could turn the tide in the heroes’ favor. His return would be particularly important for Boruto’s position. Boruto has been portrayed as a villain for a long time, and it is time for the series to restore his standing.

Perhaps Kawaki bringing Naruto back will also reveal the truth to Konoha’s villagers: Boruto is Naruto’s son, and Kawaki is the one responsible for the situation. By undoing the effects of Omnipotence, Shikamaru’s predicament might also be resolved. However, this may not happen immediately, as the series is also developing the crucial situation involving Sarada and Hida ri, which hints that Boruto could transform into Momoshiki’s form. Naruto’s return could therefore help Boruto regain control of himself in this state. All the elements revealed in the sneak peeks so far strongly hint that Naruto is indeed returning to Boruto , and his comeback could have a major impact, turning the tide in the heroes’ favor and bringing the hope that fans have long been waiting for in Boruto: Two Blue Vortex .

title: 7 Anime to Watch If You Were Disappointed With One-Punch Man Season 3
content:
Season 1 of One-Punch Man remains as one of the most iconic action anime adaptations to date. Even today, the first season is remembered fondly by fans. When Season 2 released it represented a turning point for many fans of both the anime and the manga. With Season 2 having a change of animation studios and delivering a much less compelling final product, the lead up to Season 3 caused a lot of anxiety and uncertainty. Unfortunately the fears of the fans were confirmed when Season 3 released and it had the worst reception of the three seasons right out of the gate.

With lackluster animation and a slew of other problems it seemed that many people had lost their patience with the series. Although Season 3 of One-Punch Man was a let down, there are plenty of similar shows that can scratch that itch. Whether you enjoy the parody elements, the fights, or the quirky characters, this list will have something for you.

7) Scissor Seven

Scissor Seven is a Chinese animated series available to stream on Netflix. The story follows Seven, an amnesiac hair stylist and his blue chicken friend Dai Bo. To make money the two start a low-cost assassination business where they take just about any job. Seven’s weapon of choice: a pair of hair stylist scissors that he can control at will. His skills as an assassin are subpar at best, and he often ends up just befriending his targets. Eventually, Seven gets involved in a plot much bigger than him or his small business and the memories he lost begin to slowly reveal themselves.

Unlike One-Punch Man , this is not a series where the main character walks away from every encounter unscathed. Rather the entertainment factor lies in the goofy fights and quirky characters. Each of the characters are hilarious in a different way so there will be someone for every viewer. There is some self awareness and occasional fourth wall breaking in the show as well. If you love shows with quirky casts of characters like One-Punch Man then you will love this charming, bingeable series.

6) KonoSuba: God’s Blessing on this Wonderful World!

After Kazuma Satou dies in an embarrassing manner he is faced with an arrogant goddess named Aqua that tells him he can reincarnate into a fantasy world with one item of his choosing if he wishes. To punish her for her disrespect, Kazuma chooses to take her with him to the fantasy world and together (with a couple of other eccentric companions) they try to defeat the demon king of the world. What ensues are some of the most hilarious moments you can find in an anime that plays with the tropes of a traditional isekai.

While One-Punch Man is largely a parody of Shonen and action anime tropes, KonoSuba is a parody of isekai tropes. If you enjoy the self-aware parody elements of One-Punch Man , then you will find a lot of enjoyment in Konosuba . Particularly so if you have already watched a few isekai anime. Whether you love it or hate it, the isekai genre has had countless entries in the past several years and this is the perfect show to have fun with some of the tropes that have become commonplace. Kazuma himself is from Japan so he is very aware of how fantasy isekai tropes go and can’t help but comment when he experiences them firsthand.

5) The Disastrous Life of Saiki K

The Disastrous Life of Saiki K follows Kusuo Saiki, a high school student that was born with incredible powers such as telepathy, telekinesis, and teleportation. Although Saiki is incredibly powerful he only wants to live a quiet life away from the attention that his powers bring. His attempts to avoid attention and his excuses to not use his powers lead to some pretty ridiculous situations both in school and out.

Saiki K. is a parody anime through and through. Not only are there direct references to other Shonen anime and tropes in the show (akin to something like Gintama ), but it in turn thrives off the existence of these tropes. Saiki is a near-omnipotent being, but the show makes you forget this sometimes with how fruitless his efforts to not use his powers can sometimes be. Despite Saiki’s best efforts his classmates continue to grow closer to him and, in turn, create hilarious moments for the viewers.

4) Sakamoto Days

Taro Sakamoto was once the world’s greatest hitman until he met the love of his life and settled down with her. The physique and demeanor he had as an assassin has all but vanished, and he now lives with his wife and daughter at the convenience store they own. In accordance with his wife’s wishes, Sakamoto has sworn off all killing. But when assassins begin coming after him, he is forced to employ his hitman skills once again.

The series has ridiculous fight scenes just like One-Punch Man as Sakamoto and his allies take on different enemies. You can never quite guess how a fight will play out because Sakamoto’s abilities are only revealed to the audience in small pieces at a time. Sakamoto also is careful not to actually kill his opponents, so the methods he takes to circumvent this can be truly hilarious. Sakamoto himself appears very plain looking much like Saitama, but he is still a dangerous force of nature that not even the greatest assassins to date can compete with.

3) Cautious Hero: The Hero Is Overpowered but Overly Cautious

Another entry that can be put into the isekai parody genre is Cautious Hero . As its title suggests, this story features an impossibly cautious hero named Seta Ryuuguuin that gets summoned into another world by incompetent goddess Ristarte to save the human world. The goddess thinks that Seta seems promising as a hero at first, but it quickly becomes clear that he approaches every situation and enemy encounter with the utmost caution and prep time. He refuses to fight even low level slimes until he has put in the time to train himself and is capable of obliterating them in one shot.

Cautious Hero has the overpowered trope that fans of One-Punch Man will love along with plenty of comedy. Seta is so methodical with the way he approaches the fantasy world to the point that he gets called out by other characters for acting strange. If you liked the quirky yet strong characters of One-Punch Man , or you’re a fan of RPG mechanics in shows, then this is the show for you.

2) The Daily Life of The Immortal King

Adapted from a Chinese webnovel, this series follows high school student Wang Ling. Wang Ling possesses god-like abilities, but his parents have been suppressing his power with a special talisman so that he can live a normal high school life. Even with his power suppressed, however, Wang Ling passes the first magical exam in school by defeating an ancient demon multiple times over. He struggles to keep a low profile in school and his struggles are only worsened when threats to the school begin appearing.

The series shares some things with Saiki K and Sakamoto Days in how Wang Ling has to use his powers without alerting others. There are a lot of comedic situations that he and his friends find themselves in. Wang Ling is an overpowered protagonist to be sure yet he tries to keep things lowkey despite escalating circumstances that threaten to reveal his true power. If you enjoy the unassumingness of overpowered characters like Saitama, this show will be a great watch.

1) Mashle: Magic and Muscles

Mashle: Magic and Muscles is probably the closest thing you will find to One-Punch Man currently. Although the world of Mashle has a bit more of a Harry Potter vibe , the similarities to One-Punch Man are clear from the first episode. You have a plainly drawn and largely unbothered protagonist that also possesses incredible physical strength. The main character Mashe Burnedead was born without magic in a world where magic is commonplace. At first the mages of the world think that Mashe will be helpless against them in a battle since he can’t use magic but Mashe makes up for this with his incredible physical strength and pure ignorance of magic and its rules.

This show features all the things that fans of One-Punch Man will love. Each of the characters is unique and quirky to a ridiculous level. Characters surrounding Mashe have to justify his physical feats and struggle to explain just how he excels when he doesn’t appear to use magic. This is the definitive show to check out for those who enjoy One-Punch Man .

Were you disappointed by One-Punch Man ? Which shows would you recommend to a bummed out One-Punch Man fan instead? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

Mashle: Magic and Muscles is probably the closest thing you will find to One-Punch Man currently. Although the world of Mashle has a bit more of a Harry Potter vibe , the similarities to One-Punch Man are clear from the first episode. You have a plainly drawn and largely unbothered protagonist that also possesses incredible physical strength. The main character Mashe Burnedead was born without magic in a world where magic is commonplace. At first the mages of the world think that Mashe will be helpless against them in a battle since he can’t use magic but Mashe makes up for this with his incredible physical strength and pure ignorance of magic and its rules.

This show features all the things that fans of One-Punch Man will love. Each of the characters is unique and quirky to a ridiculous level. Characters surrounding Mashe have to justify his physical feats and struggle to explain just how he excels when he doesn’t appear to use magic. This is the definitive show to check out for those who enjoy One-Punch Man .
Were you disappointed by One-Punch Man ? Which shows would you recommend to a bummed out One-Punch Man fan instead? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 11 Years Later, Dragon Ball Super Finally Redeems One of the Anime’s Worst Episodes
content:
Dragon Ball Super has released another episode of its official enhanced remake series now airing through the Fall , and with it has finally redeemed one of the classic TV series’ most notorious episodes after over a decade. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus introduced fans to the first look at a newly enhanced version of the now classic TV anime series from 2015, and with it offers new cuts, visual effects, new music and more. But fans were waiting for to see how particular fight turned out.

Dragon Ball Super’ s original TV series made waves with fans for its take on the initial fight between Goku and Beerus on King Kai’s planet, and as a result it remains one of the most ridiculed fight scenes in series’ history. But now with this newly enhanced version showing off its take on this fight between Beerus and Goku in the latest episode, fans have gotten the version they wish the TV anime had years ago. Check out an example as pointed out by @Z3RO_GRAVITY_ on X :

Dragon Ball Super ‘s New Remake Fixes Goku vs. Beerus Fight

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 2 continues its remake of the original TV anime by further condensing its events down into a shorter time. The original version of this fight didn’t happen until Episode 5, so this proves that the new edit is moving through the Battle of Gods arc at a much quicker clip. Since the TV anime was already a remake of the Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods movie, the additional materials seen in that original TV anime series always felt like filler and unnecessary to fans. Especially when it came to the way this first fight between Goku and Beerus was handled.

Though it was eventually adjusted for home media release later on, there are depictions of Goku and various spots during the fight that became memes and in-jokes among the fandom at the time. Dragon Ball Super was eventually able to overcome this admittedly terrible first impression through later arcs, but it wasn’t until the Future Trunks and Tournament of Power arcs that it finally seemed like the anime got the treatment from fans that it had been hoping for throughout the rest of its run.

What Does This Mean for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus’ Future?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be enhancing the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs before it comes to an end, and this updated version of the Goku and Beerus fight teases how some of the other big moments will be enhanced in their own ways . There’s yet to be any word on how many episodes this new remake series will be running for, nor has it been revealed whether or not the other arcs will be getting the same treatment in future anime releases.

After seeing this fight in action, however, it does make one excited for the rest of the series to potentially get a remake in the same way. There are some major fights that come after this moment, so there’s a hope that they will get the same updated treatment that fans have been treated to thus far. What are you hoping to see from Dragon Ball Super’ s remake next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Creators Address Korra Hate: “A Lot of Misogyny”
content:
The creators behind the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise addressed all of the hate Korra gets heading into Avatar: Seven Havens with their thoughts on it all. Avatar: Seven Havens is set hundreds of years after the end of the original series, and reveals that Korra is now being blamed as the one that destroyed the world and led to its current post-apocalyptic state . This has only led to more debate surrounding Korra’s role in the wider Avatar Studios franchise slate.

The debate around Korra as a main character has gotten to such a point where some even believe that creators Michael DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko themselves hate her as well. But when asked about this in a recent interview with Teen Vogue , the two creators revealed that it’s “definitely not true” that they hate Korra. In fact, Konietzko reveals that he believes these fans “…hold Korra to this totally different standard. I think there’s a lot of misogyny. I think there’s a lot of homophobia.”

Avatar: The Last Airbender Creators Address Fans’ Hate for Korra

“If people don’t like Korra as a character, they don’t like that series, that’s totally fine,” Konietzko stated when asked whether the hate against Korra was justified and if they also hated Korra . “We both love Korra, and I’m really proud of that series. The idea that Korra separated her connection with the other Avatars, it’s like, her uncle did that to her.” Then Konietzko related it to how fans view Aang, “And I’m always like, ‘Aang’s entire people were wiped out, but no one seems to hold that against Aang. But they hold Korra to this totally different standard.”

“I think there’s a lot of misogyny,” Konietzko continued. “I think there’s a lot of homophobia. Her story is an amazing one of resilience and repair. The idea that we hate Korra? I would say, well that’s definitely not true.” DiMartino also added, “She’s one of my favorite characters. The Avatars are never perfect heroes. But there’s more to Korra’s story than you see in the first couple episodes.” But this also puts that debate to bed as the hate for Korra online has now morphed into its own thing.

What Does This Mean for Korra in Avatar: Seven Havens ?

In a way, Avatar: Seven Havens is attacking all of this head on. Korra is being blamed for the current destruction of the world, and has been outright hated by all of the people in the society being revealed in the latest episodes. This might have broken the heart of Korra’s voice actor Janet Varney in the process , but it’s also likely to be revealed that something else is likely the cause behind all of that destruction. This label has been unfairly pushed onto her much like all of the hate has unfairly been pushed onto her by the fandom.

Avatar: Seven Havens is introducing two new twin Avatars at the start of their very own journey, and through the four seasons to come they’ll likely find out more about their predecessor and form their own opinions of Korra. This is the show’s chance to openly challenge all of the hate that Korra has received thus far, but it’s still going to be an uphill battle for those fans that made up their minds years before now.

How do you feel about Korra’s actions in The Legend of Korra ? Do you think she actually destroyed the world in Avatar: Seven Havens ? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Street Fighter Shows Off Incredible Anime Makeover With New Look
content:
Street Fighter has officially made its way to theaters, and it’s showing a cool new look at its also official anime makeover with a new look showing off the roster. Street Fighter and anime go hand in hand as not only has the video game franchise included many Easter Eggs and references to famous anime and manga releases, but some of the most famous adaptations in the United States are the anime ones . But it was a surprise to find the newest film include major animated sequences too.

Street Fighter 2: The Animated Movie is still one of the best and fondly remembered releases for the franchise , and Street Fighter’s new feature film outing perfectly brings back those vibes with fully animated flashback sequences for some huge moments. With animated production by a team at Titmouse ( Golden Axe, Among Us ), check out the cool anime style poster for Street Fighter below.

Street Fighter Highlights Anime Flashbacks With New Poster

As shared through Titmouse’s official Facebook page, the team is helping to highlight all of the animated sequences that they helped to contribute to the new Street Fighter film. One of the coolest decisions the film makes is to include story materials that happened before the events of the film, but only through animated sequences. With Khang Le serving as art director and Andrius Matijosius providing the character designs, Titmouse delivered essentially what is going to be the closest we’ll ever get to a new Street Fighter animated film at this point.

Street Fighter’ s flashback sequences involve Ryu and Ken’s time training under Gouken, and eventually lead to the first confrontation with Akuma before the events of the movie itself. But with this poster, we can also see all of the other characters in this style. It really does beg for a much fuller animated adaptation for the franchise in the future, and was a pretty neat way to sneak more anime onto the big screen in a way that fans might have never expected to see in action. Check out more of how they pulled off these sequences in the special behind the scenes video below.

Will There Ever Be a New Street Fighter Anime?

Unfortunately for fans of the Street Fighter franchise, things aren’t looking great for its film future right now. The film hasn’t really done well with critics on Rotten Tomatoes nor has been doing well for its initial box office outing . But with that being said, it’s done very well with fans of the original video games and that goes quite a long way. These animated sequences helped to bring those positive feelings to the forefront even more. It’s also not like it’s impossible for it to continue either.

All those involved with the Street Fighter production have teased their interest in potentially continuing with more in the future , and the film itself is open ended enough that it could lead directly into a full sequel. If not, there are already designs and proof in place that a fully animated film project would be a great way to go as well. Would you want to see a new Street Fighter anime? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Black Clover Season 2 Finally Debuts Asta’s Strongest Form After 5 Years – Watch
content:
It took five long years of waiting, but the newest episode of Black Clover Season 2 has finally brought Asta’s strongest form to anime after all this time. Black Clover Season 2 has picked up right from where the first season left off as Asta and the others are now in the midst of rematches against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad . But while the other Magic Knights are currently in the other region, Asta needed to stay behind to work on his new power up some more.

Black Clover Season 2 saw a giant devil appear and attack the Clover Kingdom, this left those behind without much way to fight against it thanks to the immense difference in strength. Thankfully, it’s not long before Asta appears with a now semi-mastered version of his transformation, Devil Union, that he had been working with together with Liebe . You can check it out below as the anime really went all out to bring the moment to life with this official clip.

Asta’s Devil Union Form Debuts in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 3

Black Clover Season 3 Episode 3 picks up after a giant demon is seen attacking the Clover Kingdom. Nothing the Magic Knights there can do is strong enough to deal any real damage, and the Wizard King’s current weakened state means he couldn’t do much against it either. But thankfully, Asta soon appears and uses his newly acquired Devil Union form to defeat with some well placed strikes. This is the form that he had been working with Liebe to master in his training with Nacht.

Asta’s Devil Union is the form that fans of the Black Clover manga have been waiting to see animated ever since Asta began his training at the tail end of the anime’s first season back in 2021. Unfortunately, this form hasn’t really been kept a secret by the anime’s production team either. Not only has it been seen with pretty much every bit of promotional materials for the second season since it was announced, but it’s also been headlining the anime’s new opening for the season . So it’s great to see it in action already.

How Strong Is Asta’s Devil Union Form in Black Clover ?

Much like how Nacht has been able to fuse his powers with the four Devils that he’s contracted with, Asta and Liebe can now unite their own abilities through Devil Union. The strength of his anti-magic has increased as a result of this form, but the drawback for now is the fact that he only has access to it for five minutes at a time before it breaks (which is what happens in the episode itself). Even then it’s really an estimate as it’s clear that Asta doesn’t really keep too close of track of the time .

Even with all of that said, Asta’s Devil Union form is a cool design that the series is going to be showing off a lot more of now (as you can see in the newly released poster above) that the fights against the Dark Triad have begun once more. This form has been seen with the Dark Triad themselves as they use their own demons to increase their strength, and puts Asta on their level.

How are you liking Asta’s Devil Union form so far? What are you hoping to see in Black Clover Season 2 before it ends? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Officially Kicks Off English Dub With Crunchyroll Release
content:
The Apothecary Diaries has now returned for the start of its English dub release for Season 3, and it’s now available with Crunchyroll. The Apothecary Diaries was one of the major franchises that fans were excited to see return for more episodes as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and is currently a few episodes into its run. But for fans of the English dub release, they have unfortunately had to wait a bit longer before getting the chance to see the new season in action themselves.

Thankfully, the wait is finally over as The Apothecary Diaries has now kicked off the English dub release for its Season 3 return this Fall. After being previously confirmed to be a part of Crunchyroll’s English dub release schedule for the Fall 2026 slate , The Apothecary Diaries is now streaming the first episode of the new season with Crunchyroll with future episodes of the new season releasing on a weekly basis. With a returning English dub voice cast in tow, fans of the series are going to want to jump in.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 English Dub Voice Cast & Release Schedule Revealed

Following the debut of the first episode on Friday, October 16th, Crunchyroll has confirmed that new episodes of The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 English dub will then be releasing on a weekly basis. With the Japanese language release only two episodes ahead thus far, it’s not going to be too wide of a gap between each version either. The voice cast has been revealed too and new additions to the series include Jad Saxton as the mysterious “White Lady,” who is going to be central to the core mystery that Maomao needs to get to the bottom of this season.

The returning English voice cast for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 includes Emi Lo as Maomao, Kaiji Tang as Jinshi, Suzie Yeung as Shisui, Anne Yatco as Kyou-u, Nazeeh Tarsha as Guard, Wendy Powell as Madam, Oscar Seung as Ukyou, Seth Fuentes as Lihkau, Eli Farmer as Onsou, Caleb Yen as Lahan, Alex Mai as Emperor, Ricco Fajardo as Lakan, Reshel Mae as Lishu, Monica Rial as the Narrator, and more. Now is the perfect time to catch up with it all too.

What’s Going on With The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has begun to spark a whole new mystery as not only is the region on the cusp of a famine with a mysterious horde of locusts seemingly making their way through the fields, there’s also a mysterious woman walking around the poorer sections with some kind of plan in mind. But all the while, Maomao has been looking at the whole picture to try and figure out what’s been going on this whole time. It’s only just gotten started, however.

The Apothecary Diaries has confirmed that Season 3 will be running for 24 episodes in total, with a single cour of 12 episodes planned for the Fall . The series will then be taking a few months off before returning for its second half sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. With a new movie releasing across theaters in Japan in between the two halves, it’s going to be a big year for fans of this franchises.

Are you excited to jump into the English dub for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3? What are you hoping to see in the new episodes? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Bleach Final Season Preview Reveals First Look & Synopsis for Final Episodes
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity is gearing up to return for the first of its final two episodes, and the first look images and story synopsis are now giving an idea of what fans can expect to see go down. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War returned for its fourth and final season of episodes earlier this Summer, but unfortunately it had announced a surprise month long delay before the release of its final two episodes . But thankfully the wait is finally over.

With the penultimate episode of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity making its debut this week following its hiatus, the franchise has dropped the first look images for Episode 49. Teasing the final battle against Yhwach, the synopsis for the episode sets up the multi-regional fight with many characters involved. And this is a huge departure from how it all went down in Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga version of the events.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 49 Preview Images Revealed

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 49 will be officially making its debut on Monday, October 19th at 8:30AM PT with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ . This will be the Japanese language audio version with English subtitles, and the English dubbed version of Episode 49 will be launching with Hulu on November 23rd at 8:30AM PT. As detailed by the anime’s official website, the penultimate episode of the series is titled “The Blade,” and picks up right after the cliffhanger as Yhwach invades all three major regions as part of his takeover.

“Transcending dimensions, Yhwach simultaneously appears in the Soul Society, the Human World, and Hueco Mundo, declaring his intention to reduce the world to nothingness and create a new world without the ‘fear of life’ or the ‘fear of death,’” the synopsis for the episode teases. “However, Ichigo, who rose from the depths of despair, and his allies, including the Soul Reapers and Arrancar, have not yet given up on this world. In each of the three realms, the final bloody battle against Yhwach begins.” Which is a total departure from the manga .

How Is Bleach ‘s Anime Ending Different From the Manga?

There are only two and a half chapters left from Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga for the anime to adapt with these final episodes, and about 75% of those chapters are focused on the epilogue that takes place years after the fight . The final fight with Yhwach himself is only about ten or so pages, and didn’t see him fully invading all three worlds. The previously released trailer and these first look images also tease that other characters will be involved in fending off Yhwach, and that’s something that didn’t take place in the original. Which means the anime is making this the most expansive final fight yet.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has been making all sorts of welcome changes to the original way the final arc played out in the manga as Kubo has been working closely together with the production team to make it the most complete version of the story. If the anime is able to stick the landing with these changes in the final two episodes, then this is going to be one of the most memorable finales yet.

What are you hoping to see in Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ‘s final two episodes? How have you liked the final season overall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
